Election complémentaire à la Municipalité d’Yverdon | 24 heures

The voter turnout ⁣was 46.63%.

Interview with Maya Maharjan: Organizing the Yverdon-les-Bains Municipal Election The⁢ city‍ of Yverdon-les-Bains is preparing for an ​election⁣ to fill the vacancy left by the late ‌Jean-claude ‌Ruchet. Maya Maharjan, the responsible officer,⁤ discusses the details of ​the upcoming election, the‌ candidates, and the benefits of participation.
Editor: Can you⁢ provide an overview of​ the upcoming election in Yverdon-les-Bains? Maya Maharjan: The ⁤upcoming election⁢ in Yverdon-les-Bains is a ‍complementary ‍election to fill the vacancy in the⁢ Municipalité d’Yverdon. This is an ‍importent election⁤ to ⁤ensure the ‌continuity of our city’s governance and to give residents the chance to voice their preferences for future leadership.
Editor: Who​ are the candidates for this election? Maya Maharjan: The candidates standing in this election ⁤include julien wicki from the PS party, Ruben‌ Ramchurn, Gildo dall’aglio from the ​right alliance, ⁤and‍ Mergim Dibrani who is an⁣ autonomous candidate. This diverse group of candidates brings various perspectives and ideas to the table, which is ⁢beneficial for the city.
Editor: What are the key issues and concerns that the candidates are​ addressing? Maya Maharjan: The⁢ candidates are ⁤addressing a range of issues ‍pertinent to the city’s growth and ‌well-being. These include local economy growth, infrastructure improvements, community engagement, healthcare access, and environmental ‌sustainability. Julien​ Wicki has led with 39.46% of the votes, while Ruben Ramchurn secured ⁢30%, indicating ​strong support for‌ their visions and approaches⁤ to these issues.
Editor: How can ​residents participate in this election? Maya ⁤Maharjan: Residents of Yverdon-les-bains ⁤who are eligible to vote⁢ can participate by casting their votes in the election.‌ It’s⁢ crucial for everyone to exercise‌ their ​right to vote and make their voices heard. To submit ​a candidacy, interested parties can⁤ contact me directly through the designated channels mentioned in ‍the official announcement.
Editor: What measures are being taken to‍ ensure fair and obvious voting? Maya ⁣Maharjan: We are ‍implementing robust measures to ensure⁤ the fairness and ⁣transparency of the election. This includes stringent voter verification ⁤processes, secure⁤ voting systems, and independent⁣ monitoring⁤ of the ‌election process. These steps are essential to maintain the ​integrity of ‌the election and ensure that every vote is counted accurately.
Editor: ‍What is‍ the expected turnout for this election? Maya Maharjan: Based on past elections and current indications,⁣ we anticipate ⁢a significant turnout. The last election saw a voter⁢ turnout of 46.63%, and we hope to see similar or higher engagement this time around. High voter turnout ​strengthens the democratic process and ensures that the​ elected representatives truly​ reflect the will of the people.
Conclusion The upcoming election in Yverdon-les-Bains offers a ⁤critical opportunity for the city’s ⁤residents to participate in shaping​ their community’s future. With a diverse‍ pool of⁢ candidates and key issues being addressed, the election promises to be insightful and impactful. Maya ‌Maharjan emphasizes⁢ the ⁢importance of voter participation⁣ and the ⁤fairness of the electoral process, inviting all eligible residents to cast their votes ​and contribute ⁢to ‍the city’s ⁤progress.
